title: Term Life Insurance Face Decreases: Permanent Coverage Counted Toward the Band
content:
When the premium released by a Term Life Insurance face decrease is worked out, the permanent face counted toward the band is chosen by the owner's Ashgrove permanent coverage on the same insured — the Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance policies in force on the insured's life:

| In force on record for the insured | Permanent face counted toward the band |
|---|---|
| an Ashgrove whole life policy and an Ashgrove universal life policy | both permanent face amounts |
| exactly one of the two | that one permanent face amount |
| neither | nothing |

The band measurement face of each face — the current face and the requested face alike — is that face plus the permanent face counted.

**Cases (hypothetical).** Current face 600000, requested face 400000, an in-force Ashgrove Lifetime Guarantee UL of 150000 on the insured and no whole life policy in force: the band measurement faces are 750000 and 550000. With an in-force Ashgrove Whole Life Paid-Up at 100 of 100000 added, they become 850000 and 650000. With neither permanent policy in force, they are 600000 and 400000.
